senses.gloss:
Icchaṭaka
poet. Sbhv. 2337. C.. Icchāla, Smv. p. 309, same verse Sbhv. 2305, a..

Icchā
of Mudgala gotra; ancestor of Nityānanda, (Sarvasiddhāntarāja. BBRAS. 264).

Icchārāma
son of Keśavarāma, grandson of Hīrānanda, great grandson of Jagadīśamiśra an. father of Śivadattamiśra (a. of Uttarapakṣāvalī). Skt. Col.. Ben. 1909, p. 2 (no. 1787).

Icchārāmasvāmin
pupil of Nārāyaṇasvāmin, disciple of Saṅkalparāma.
--Pañcaprakaraṇī or Satsukhānubhava (vedānta). Alph. List Beng. Govt. 1891. p. 61 (But on p. 124 in the same catal. Icchārāma's teacher N. is given a. the a.). Hall p. 129. L. 4244. Mithilā. Nasik IV. 20.

Icchārāma_Bhaṭṭajī
son of Gopālaji. Vallabhīya.
--C. Pradīpa on the Aṇubhāṣya of Vallabha on Br. sūtra of Bādarāyaṇa.
Pt.. N. S. Press, Bombay, I921.

Icchāla(?_Icchaṭa)
poet. Q. in Smv. p. 309. Same verse, a.. in Sbhv. 2305. Same a. Icchaṭa ?
